text:
maria: Quick sync — PR #482 in docs/provisioning: adding 'tenant sample payloads' for Dedicated onboarding. Need review on: 1) isolation wording around 'soft-preempt' vs 'eviction', 2) SLA table phrasing (percentile vs p99 wording), 3) python SDK snippet for allocate_reserved_capacity() and terraform example link. Can reviewers triage? TL;DR: tiny edits expected.

kevin: looking now. Can we add a short 'expected behavior during warmstart' note? There's a mismatch between autoscale docs and runtime behavior.

maria: yes, good catch. I stubbed a 'warmstart' bullet but it's vague. Proposed sentence: "Warmstart may delay capacity availability by up to 60s due to container initialization; use burst_capacity for immediate spikes." Thoughts?

raj: Prefer 'graceful preemption' instead of 'soft-preempt' — 'soft-preempt' reads as best-effort which confuses users w/ eviction policy. :thinking_face: 

kevin: Agreed re 'graceful preemption'. Also the python SDK snippet needs to show retry/backoff. Pasting a minimal example:

`````
from redwood import DedicatedClient
import time
client = DedicatedClient()
for attempt in range(3):
    try:
        client.allocate_reserved_capacity(tenant_id='acme', capacity=4)
        break
    except Exception as e:
        time.sleep(2 ** attempt)
        continue
`````

docs-bot: CI run: docs-lint passed, link-check failed (1 broken link -> external KMS doc)

elaine: I can fix the KMS link. We migrated the KMS guide to /security/kms/last-update-2025 — will update the PR.

maria: Thanks. Also we should include a tiny Terraform module example for reserved capacity with tenant label. I added a reference but not a full snippet. @kevin can we reuse snippet from infra repo?

kevin: I'll extract a minimal module, will push to branch in 30m. Also suggest we convert SLA table to '99th percentile latency' row rather than 'p99' to keep copy friendly for legal.

raj: One more: isolation decorator examples need to show both 'tenant_label' and 'group_id' to avoid confusion in multi-tenant configs.

maria: Plan: kevin + elaine update PR with code & link fixes, raj to propose exact phrasing for preemption & isolation, I'll re-run docs-lint and merge after CI green. Anyone object to merge after CI passes?

kevin: :thumbsup: 

elaine: :eyes: fixing link now.

docs-bot: CI run: link-check passed, build succeeded. PR #482 -> 'docs/provisioning/tenant-samples.md' ready for final review.

maria: Merging in 10 unless more comments. Thanks all :rocket:
